spans.s:
1. मूत, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see rt. 1. मू), moved,
in काम-मूत, q. v.

2. मूत, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see rt. 1. मीव्), bound,
tied; woven; (अस्, अम्), m. n., Ved. a woven basket;
a woven band of cloth or fillet.
—मूत-कार्य, अस्,
आ, अम्, consisting of plaited work or basket work.

मूत 1. and 2. मूत. See under rt. 1. मीव्
and rt. 1. मू.
मुत्कल मुत्कल, अस्, m., N. of a man.

मुत्खलिन् मुत्खलिन्, ई, m., N. of a Deva-
putra.
मुत्य मुत्य, अम्, n. a pearl.
मूतक, अम्, n., Ved. a little basket.
मूतिब मूतिब, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

मूत्र मूत्र, अम्, n. (probably connected
with rt. 1. मिह्; but according to Uṇādi-s.

.
fr. rt. मुच्, to discharge; by others connected with
rts. 1. मीव् and मिन्व्), the fluid secreted by the
kidneys, urine.
—मूत्र-कर, अस् ई, अम्, producing
urine.
—मूत्र-कृच्छ्र, अम्, n. painful discharge
of urine in minute quantities, strangury; a class of
urinary affections (of which eight kinds are enume-
rated, including gravel, stone, &c.).
—मूत्र-कृच्-
छ्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ, labouring under painful discharge
of urine, suffering from strangury.
—मूत्र-कृत-
वासस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. steeped or soaked in urine.
—मूत्र-कोश, अस्, m. the scrotum.
—मूत्र-
क्षय, अस्, m. insufficient secretion of urine.
—मू-
त्र-ग्रन्थि, इस्, m. a knot or induration on the
neck of the bladder.
—मूत्र-घात = मूत्राघात,
q. v.
—मूत्र-जठर, अस्, अम्, m. n. swelling of
the belly in consequence of retention of urine.
—मू-
त्र-दोष, अस्, m. urinary disease.
—मूत्र-निरो-
ध, अस्, m. obstruction or retention of urine.
—मू-
त्र-पतन, अस्, m. the civet cat.
—मूत्र-पथ,
अस्, m. the urinary passage.
—मूत्र-परीक्षा, f.
examination of urine, uroscopy; N. of a chapter of
the Śārṅgadhara-saṃhitā.
—मूत्र-पुट, अम्, n.
‘urine-cavity,’ the lower belly.
—मूत्र-पुरीष,
अम्, n. urine and excrement.
—मूत्र-प्रसेक, अस्,
m. the urethra.
—मूत्र-फला, f. Cucumis Utilissi-
mus (= कर्कटी); another species of cucumber (=
त्रपुषी).
—मूत्र-भावित, अस्, आ, अम्, saturated
with urine.
—मूत्र-मार्ग, अस्, m. ‘urine-canal,’
the urethra.
—मूत्रमार्ग-निरोधन, अम्, n.
obstruction of the urethra.
—मूत्र-वर्धक, अस्,
इका, अम्, increasing urine, diuretic.
—मूत्र-वह,
अस्, आ, अम्, conveying urine.
—मूत्र-विबन्ध-
घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, preventing suppression of urine,
causing discharge of urine.
—मूत्र-विष, अस्, आ,
अम्, poisonous with urine.
—मूत्र-वृद्धि, इस्, f.
copious secretion of urine.
—मूत्र-शकृत्, त्, n.
urine and excrement.
—मूत्र-शुक्र, अम्, n. a
disease in which semen and urine are ejected toge-
ther.
—मूत्र-शूल, अस्, m. urinary colic.
—मूत्र-
सङ्क्षय, अस्, m. insufficient secretion of urine
(= मूत्र-क्षय).
—मूत्र-सङ्ग, अस्, m. urinary
obstruction, a painful and bloody discharge of urine.
—मूत्र-सङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, suffering from the
above disease.
—मूत्राघात (˚र-आघ्˚), अस्, m.
affection of the urine, urinary disease (of which twelve
or thirteen kinds are enumerated).
—मूत्रातीत
(˚र-अत्˚), अस्, m. ‘past the proper time for voiding
urine,’ a particular kind of retention of urine.
—मू-
त्राशय (˚र-आश्˚), अस्, m. ‘urine-receptacle,’ the
lower belly.
—मूत्रासाद = मूत्रौक-साद, q. v.
—मूत्रोत्सङ्ग (˚र-उत्˚) = मूत्र-सङ्ग, q. v.
—मूत्रौक-साद (˚र-ओक्˚), अस्, m. a disease in
[]
which the urine assumes various colours and is voided
with pain.

मूत्रय, Nom. P. मूत्रयति, -यितुम्, to dis-
charge urine; to make water against or upon (with
acc.): Intens. मोमूत्र्यते.

मूत्रल, अस्, आ, अम्, promoting (the secretion of)
urine, diuretic; (आ), f. Cucumis Utilissimus; another
species of cucumber, = वालुकी; (अम्), n. a species
of cucumber (= त्रपुष).

मूत्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, voided as urine, discharged
like urine; soiled with urine.

मूत्र्य, अस्, आ, अम्, urinary, belonging or relating
to urine.
